 Adv. Panchanan Hajra,
 ...for the Petitioners.
 Adv. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay
 Adv. Priyabrata Batabyal,
 ...for the State.
Affidavit of service filed on behalf of the petitioners is  taken on record.

The petitioners complain that their land was  requisitioned according to the West Bengal Land  (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948 (hereinafter  referred to as the "said Act of 1948") but the land was not  acquired subsequently.

entities.text: West Bengal Land  (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the meantime the said Act of  1948 stood repealed with effect from March 31, 1997.

The petitioners filed a representation before the 4 th  respondent on 15th December, 2022 for release of their land and payment of compensation but the said representation has not been considered till date.
The petitioners pray for consideration of the said representation by the concerned authority.

Having considered the submissions made by the learned counsels appearing on behalf of the parties and the material on record, I dispose of the writ petition with a direction upon the 4th respondent to Ramkinkar Dutta & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 15 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45794457/
